tasks.title: Enforce workspace continuation conflicts
tasks.goal: Protect one existing parked writer across nodes and change scopes.
steps: Use workspace-wide state/lease authority, retaining exact owner target and request.
Reject competing node/change work before new state/effects are emitted.
Implement explicit cancel/displace plans that preserve foreign outputs and state what can be resumed or abandoned.
positive_cases: Same continuation resumes; separate worktree state remains independent.
negative_cases: Force flag or other member cannot silently displace parked work.
Cancellation cannot delete outputs owned by another request.

tasks.title: Recover hosted continuation and outcome after interruption
tasks.goal: Make one accepted task resumable without duplicate provider execution.
steps: Exercise interruption before task publication, after publication and after output acceptance.
Reuse domain journals and M-16 operation linkage to distinguish pending, completed and unknown effects.
Revalidate exact task/output fingerprints on recovery; expose abandonment separately from successful completion.
positive_cases: A completed exact hosted output is accepted once across reconnect/restart.
negative_cases: Repeated reply, changed output or incomplete journal cannot duplicate production.
Hosted mode never calls an external provider.
